target: Observed S-NPP VIIRS equivalent monthly common-grid centroid cell-days, not fire truth
units: VIIRS-equivalent centroid cell-days per complete UTC calendar month
cohort: Explicit exact source/product-version pair per regional experiment; never pooled or relabelled
eligibility: Every UTC date has both request-verified exports, known totals, one exact product-version pair and no documented processing gaps
training_inputs: eligible monthly MODIS and S-NPP counts

partition.forward_selection: inner earlier-training-years-only; at least two earlier years

interval.method: symmetric absolute log1p residuals; finite-sample upper order statistic ceil((n+1)*0.9); clip lower count at zero
interval.warning: Empirical calibration, not guaranteed coverage under temporal dependence; baseline separately calibrated on same dates

gates.authority: proposed project gates; not NASA standards; approval required before fitting

report: all twelve complete-month annual errors only
claims_excluded: blind confirmation from previously inspected periods
amendment: Any methodological or gate change requires a new immutable protocol ID, new human approval and reevaluation. Previously inspected inputs remain retrospective.
